title: Kissed Indulgent Filipino Runner Beans Tinola
description: A salty and crumbly Filipino dish featuring runner beans, served as a tinola, which is a traditional Filipino ginger-based soup. This recipe is nut-free-friendly and perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: In a large pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced ginger and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the fish sauce, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Add the trimmed runner beans and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the sliced green chili and cook for another minute.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the tinola hot, garnished with diced patola if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
